# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `enginy` MCP server pointing at Enginy's hosted endpoint (`https://openapi.enginy.ai/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with Enginy user login — no API key to configure.
- Logo: Enginy's favicon from the source of docs.enginy.ai.
